# BoFu, Baby

> Bottom-of-funnel content engines for B2B companies: pages written for buyers who are already shopping, built to rank on Google and to get named by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Claude when those buyers ask who to use. Published prices: the BoFu Map is $1,500 (credited in full); the 90-Day BoFu Build is $22,500 over 90 days ($9,000, $7,500, $6,000); Defend & Expand is $4,500/mo after; Monitor is $1,500/mo.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.bofubaby.com/): What BoFu, Baby does, how AI citation (AEO) is measured, and the five-part engine
- [Pricing](https://www.bofubaby.com/pricing/): Step-down fee, what ships each month, Defend & Expand, guarantee, add-ons, terms and FAQ
- [The BoFu Map](https://www.bofubaby.com/bofu-map/): $1,500, five business days, the complete bottom-of-funnel keyword set with an AI citation baseline
- [Services](https://www.bofubaby.com/services/): Published offers. Free 15-minute call, the BoFu Map ($1,500), the 90-Day BoFu Build ($22,500), Defend & Expand ($4,500/mo), Monitor ($1,500/mo). Full schedule on Pricing.
- [About](https://www.bofubaby.com/about/): Colin Dowling writes the notes. Podcast: Modern Business Life (https://modernbusiness.life/)
- [Resources](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/)
- [Contact](https://www.bofubaby.com/contact/): Book a free 15-minute call
- [Free 15-minute keyword plan](https://www.bofubaby.com/15minutes5xtraffic/): Five BOFU keywords, a rank plan for each, AI citation gap
- [How to get your B2B company cited by ChatGPT](https://www.bofubaby.com/how-to-get-cited-by-chatgpt/): ChatGPT cites listicles, directories, Reddit, and pages that answer a buying question in the first lines. How a B2B company gets into that set.
- [AEO specialist vs SEO agency](https://www.bofubaby.com/aeo-specialist-vs-seo-agency/): An AEO-only specialist tracks mentions. A traditional SEO agency sells traffic. Here is how both differ from decision pages built to rank and get cited.
- [Bottom-of-funnel content for B2B SaaS](https://www.bofubaby.com/bofu-content-for-saas/): Comparisons, alternatives, pricing-intent and use-case pages for B2B SaaS: the pages buyers read before they purchase, wired to a conversion and to citation.

## Posts
<!-- posts:start -->
- [Why ChatGPT Can't Describe Your Company, and How Consistent Messaging Fixes It](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/why-chatgpt-cant-describe-your-company/): When your site, team and listings describe you differently, AI answer engines get confused. Here's how to make messaging consistent enough to be cited.
- [Random Acts of Marketing: Why Disconnected Activity Doesn't Produce Pipeline](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/random-acts-of-marketing/): Conferences, ads and posts with no strategy behind them rarely create pipeline. Here's how to tie marketing activity to the buyers who are ready to buy.
- [Build Personas Around Buying Drivers, Not Channels](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/personas-buying-drivers-not-channels/): Most B2B personas describe where buyers hang out, not why they buy. Here's how to build personas around each buyer's real drivers and content needs.
- [If You Can't Name the Problem You Solve, Your Content Won't Rank or Convert](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/name-the-problem-you-solve/): Teams that can't name the problem they solve write vague content buyers skip. Here's how to find the problem in buyers' words and build pages around it.
- [How to Measure Which Deals Your Influencers, Analysts and Partners Actually Touched](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/measure-influencer-impact-on-pipeline/): Influence is hard to track, so it gets cut first. Here's a simple way to measure which deals analysts, influencers and partners touched.
- [Me-Too Positioning Gets Ignored: How to Differentiate When Your Product Sounds Like Everyone Else's](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/me-too-positioning/): If you sound like every competitor, buyers and the experts they trust tune you out. Here's how to find a real point of difference and say it plainly.
- [Mass Media Is Fading. Where B2B Marketing Should Go Instead](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/mass-media-is-fading/): Broad-reach channels keep losing attention. Here's where B2B buyers go instead, and how to show up in the searches and AI answers that decide deals.
- [Marketing to Buyers Who Don't Know Your Category Exists](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/marketing-to-buyers-who-dont-know-category-exists/): When buyers don't know a product exists for their problem, they keep patching a homegrown fix. Here's how to show up in the searches they make instead.
- [Writing Content Technical Buyers Won't Dismiss](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/content-technical-buyers-wont-dismiss/): Technical buyers sniff out marketing fluff fast and dismiss the brand. Here's how to write B2B content engineers and technical leaders actually trust.
- [When Everyone Assumes AI Wrote It: How to Make Content Buyers Still Trust](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/content-buyers-trust-ai-era/): AI made content cheap, so buyers now assume it's generic. Here's how to make B2B content that proves a real person with real experience wrote it.
- [Build Distribution Before You Launch: Why a Founder's Public Presence Matters](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/build-distribution-before-launch/): Launching without an audience means starting from zero. Here's how founders can build public presence and distribution before the product is ready.
- [Stop Branding on Gut Feel: Simple Ways to Find Out What's Right](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/branding-research-not-gut-feel/): Too many companies do what they think is right instead of finding out. Here's how to use quick, cheap buyer research before your next brand decision.
- [Afraid to Niche Down? Why a Narrower Market Makes Marketing Easier](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/afraid-to-niche-down/): Niching down feels like shrinking your market. In practice it makes buyers recognize you faster and makes bottom-of-funnel content far easier to win.
- [What you leave the free 15-minute call with](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/what-the-free-15-minute-call-includes/): On a free 15-minute call you get five high-intent searches, where you are missing from them, and whether the AIs are naming you or a competitor. You keep it either way.
- [Ranking and getting cited are two different jobs](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/ranking-and-getting-cited/): BoFu, Baby measures AI citation separately from rank: ten buyer-intent questions, five runs each, across four platforms. That is 200 checks a month.
- [Bottom-of-funnel search is a list you can finish](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/bottom-of-funnel-search-is-finite/): Bottom-of-funnel searches in a B2B category are finite: alternatives, versus, pricing, best-for, switching and integrations. The BoFu Map counts that list.
